model.name: YOLO26n
model.graph_boundary: six raw detection heads, decode + NMS on host

input.note: test_640.mp4 (640x640, 30 FPS, 394 frames), derived from a 3840x2160 traffic clip; all three devices ran this same file.

decode.implementation: common/postprocess_common.py + common/postprocess_yolo26.py (shared by all three runners)

timing.note: device_service_fps: 10 collect() intervals with the pipeline kept full (4 inferences in flight), i.e. the rate the device can serve. infer_only_per_frame / pipeline_without_io: measured in a pass with no drawing and no encoding, so it is the host pipeline rate (read + letterbox + submit + decode + NMS). python_end_to_end_fps: the annotated pass, including drawing and MP4 writing.
